session_id.description: Unique session identifier assigned by the server
session_id.title: Session Id

negotiated_capabilities.description: Intersection of proposed and supported capabilities
negotiated_capabilities.title: Negotiated Capabilities

negotiated_version.description: Protocol version both sides agreed on
negotiated_version.title: Negotiated Version

trust_tier.description: Trust tier granted to the client. Must be one of: internal, owner, verified, external
trust_tier.title: Trust Tier

server_nonce.description: Server-side 256-bit hex nonce for binding proof
server_nonce.title: Server Nonce

server_ephemeral_key.description: Server ephemeral X25519 public key (32 bytes, base64url, no padding). Clients MUST refuse a session.established without it.
server_ephemeral_key.title: Server Ephemeral Key

binding_token.description: DEPRECATED — legacy field that carried the binding secret in the clear. Servers MUST NOT send it; clients MUST ignore it. The binding key is derived via X25519 key agreement instead.
binding_token.title: Binding Token

confirm_nonce.description: Single-use nonce for replay protection of session.confirm. Generated by the server via HandshakeStateMachine.issue_confirm_nonce(). The client MUST echo this value in its SessionConfirmBody.
confirm_nonce.title: Confirm Nonce

resumed.description: Whether the previous session was successfully resumed
resumed.title: Resumed
